players.product: MBE-grown InP PIN / APD photodetector epiwafers for 100G-200G data-center optical transceivers, plus GaAs VCSEL / pHEMT and InP HBT epiwafers

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 revenue NTD 256,194 thousand, up 7.3% YoY and down 22.9% QoQ; gross margin 34.0% (Q1 2026: 47.8%); operating income NTD 21,590 thousand; net income NTD 18,876 thousand; EPS NTD 0.43.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue NTD 256,194 thousand (+7.3% YoY, -22.9% QoQ); gross margin 34.0%; EPS NTD 0.43

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 sales mix: InP epiwafers 48.7%, GaAs epiwafers 24.0%, GaSb and service revenue 27.0%; by application, fiber-optic networks 36.6% and high-speed transmission devices 19.8%.
quarterly_data.figure: InP 48.7% of Q2 2026 sales; fiber-optic networks 36.6%

quarterly_data.signal: InP: the global InP substrate shortage continues; customers have started accepting epiwafers grown on other substrate makers' substrates; orders from major customers continue, and small and mid-size customers are accelerating and enlarging orders to secure production slots. The company keeps seeking more InP substrate allocation from substrate makers and, through major optical-communication makers, to buy more substrate.

GaAs: GaAs substrate and gallium source-material prices rose again in Q3 2026 while orders from major customers keep increasing; the company is adjusting prices overall. Quantum-dot (QD) laser epiwafer development is on schedule with lasers under test at customers and research institutes, and 200G VCSEL epiwafers are in qualification.

Plan: the U.S. federal CHIPS Act contract is expected to be signed within the year; Phase II expansion of the new plant is under way and expected to be completed in Q1 2027; Texas CHIPS Act reimbursements are being claimed on schedule.
quarterly_data.figure: Phase II plant expansion completion expected Q1 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Other lines: GaSb substrate prices raised in a first round with a second under way, defense orders produced under contract and mass-production orders hoped for in 2027; a custom MBE system moved from lease to purchase, with a buy-and-host model under discussion with major semiconductor equipment makers and a contract hoped for this quarter; GaN regrowth is moving to volume orders with local production and delivery in Taiwan.

IntelliEPI.why: MBE epitaxy foundry whose InP PIN photodetector epiwafers go into optical transceiver modules for AI data centers; InP epiwafers were 49.56% of 2025 revenue and drove 50.49% revenue growth.
IntelliEPI.evidence: IntelliEPI annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-28-2026): 'IET is the world top one InP PIN suppliers, which account for almost 100% 100G-200G InP PIN commercial orders worldwide ... IET supplies products to three of the world's top four optoelctronic companies'; top customer E company buys 'InP PIN wafers used in optical transceiver module for large-scale data center'.
